400 error when the prompt exceeds the model's maximum context length

```php title="PHP"
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

require_once __DIR__ . '/vendor/autoload.php';

use Liter\Llm\LiterLlm;
use Liter\Llm\ChatCompletionRequest;
$request = \Liter\Llm\ChatCompletionRequest::from_json(json_encode(["messages" => [["content" => "Very long prompt that exceeds the context window...", "role" => "user"]], "model" => "gpt-4"]));
try {
    LiterLlm::chat($request);
} catch (Throwable $error) {
    echo $error::class . ': ' . $error->getMessage() . "\n";
}
```
